core_reduction.asb_fail: A sampled q-row window J=[(s-1)q+1,sq] has no primes.
core_reduction.low_sifted_set: R_z(J)={n in J : gcd(n, prod_{ell<=z} ell)=1}, z=p^alpha.
core_reduction.cover_lower_bound: ASB-Fail implies |R_z(J)| <= |D_z(J)|, where D_z(J)=union_{z<ell<=p}(R_z(J) cap ell Z).
core_reduction.incidence_correction: Raw incidence sum_{z<ell<=p}|R_z(J) cap ell Z| can exceed |R_z(J)| in samples, so the target must be point coverage or incidence minus duplicate energy.

next_target: RPD-or-CRTDefect: prove |R_z(J) cap P| >= eta |R_z(J)| on all sampled ASB windows, or show failure triggers CRTDefect/Tail-anchor/OSPC.
rigidity_inputs: low-prime slope locks removed before high-prime incidence
square bound n<=p^2 ensures every composite has a prime factor <=p
review_conclusion: Do not claim ASB proved yet. ASB-RHC is equivalent to positive prime density inside the low-sifted set R_z(J). The remaining hard point is RPD-or-CRTDefect, not raw incidence.
